title: common
description: The grammar every wilanis document shares. A document is one JSON file whose $schema names its kind (@wilanis/<kind>.schema.json). Every reference is a path from the source root: @features/tasks/tasks.port.json, or through a project alias such as @tasks/tasks.port.json. Plugins are alias roots: @std, @http. An operation is path#operation.

ident.description: A field, input, param, operation or node identifier.

alias.description: An alias root: @ followed by a kebab-case name.

path.description: A document path from the root (@...) or an alias (@name/...), ending in .json.

opRef.description: path#operation: one operation of a port.

typeRef.description: A type: string, number, boolean, unknown, or the path of a shape; any of them followed by [] for a list of it. Native contracts may also write type (a param whose value is a type reference) and $T variables bound by such params. No bare object, no bare array.

inlineObject.description: An object type written in place. Legal in contracts and inside shapes; a graph's in/out and a trigger's in/out name a shape.

open.description: Keys beyond fields: false (default), true (values unknown), or the type every extra value has.

field.description: One field, input or param: its type, whether it is required (default true), what it means.

secret.description: Redacted in every report and log.

enum.description: For strings: the closed set of legal values.

binds.description: Native contracts only, on a param of type : the variable its value binds, so returns can name it.

sourcePath.description: A dotted read: in.field, nodeId, nodeId.field.deeper, const.name.

source.description: Where a value comes from: a dotted read, a list of sources (builds a list), or an object of sources (builds an object; {} is the empty object). Strings are always references; literals live in constants.

paramValue.description: A literal of any JSON type. A string may carry {{root.path}} templates: alone it takes the value and its type, embedded in text it is interpolated. Roots: in (the graph's or operation's input) and a resolver name; a resolver's own in may also read request.

resolvers.description: name -> an operation whose result params read as {{name.path}}. The one place request.* (the trigger kind's context) may be read.
